g.text: table_ is built once from gg_ at start-up. Query(id_a, id_b, pose_a, pose_b) answers one question: would footprint id_a at pose_a overlap footprint id_b at pose_b? Everything that

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: decides 'blocked' or 'in the way' is built on it.
